canDos.statement: I can distinguish evidence, assumptions and implications in a complex formal argument.
I can follow extended formal discourse that changes stance, qualification and emphasis.
I can compare competing interpretations without collapsing important nuance.
I can present a structured position with explicit caveats, implications and priorities.
I can synthesize evidence from several viewpoints into a qualified written conclusion.
I can adapt rhetorical force and register to audience, purpose and evidential certainty.
I can evaluate causal claims by separating correlation, assumptions and limitations.
I can negotiate institutional trade-offs and build common ground across constraints.
I can reframe disagreement and answer counterarguments precisely rather than rhetorically.
I can produce an integrated recommendation that addresses feasibility, accountability and long-term consequences.

productiveTasks.title: Synthesize two interpretations aloud
productiveTasks.prompt: Present two plausible interpretations of the same evidence, explain what each assumes, and give a qualified conclusion.
productiveTasks.situation: C1 source synthesis and epistemic control
